column1: # Texts of the options page of Quick Loot (English
column2: applies to every language, German.csv wins for German). The ids are what main.lua names as "@SPASS_QL_...".
Take what you look at with one key press, without walking over or any animation.
The key that takes the target. Other key names (F-keys, Space, ...) go into config.toml.
A key that has to be held with the key to take something (none = the key alone).
Take items that lie on the ground.
Loot dead and knocked-out humans, the bodies of the beach and carcasses.
A locked chest is opened with the matching key from the inventory (never lockpicked).
How close the target has to be.
A game log line for every item taken from the ground.
The sound of the take animation for items from the ground (apple, gold, wood, ...).
After one pick-up sound the next waits this long, so holding the key does not pile them up. 0 = every item.
Hold the key to take everything in reach, one target after the other.
The time between two targets while the key is held.
assess = the game's own reaction (people who see you comment or threaten), veto = nothing is taken while someone sees you, ignore = nobody reacts.
Veto only: how close a human who sees you has to be to stop quick loot. 0 = never.
